title: I wanted to make a game inspired by the old Flash RPG games, so I made Stick Life
author: jewfro7861
selftext:
I grew up loving games like Stick RPG and always wanted something that captured that same feeling but with a bigger world and more things to do.

So I started building Stick Life: The Daily Grind using AI coding agents, with a focus on keeping that old-school Flash game charm while expanding the life sim mechanics.

It's got careers, gambling (With a 10% luck bonus for smoking and drinking while you play), housing, businesses, minigames, and a bunch of other ridiculous stuff to mess around with.

I released it on Steam earlier this month, and I've been having a blast improving it based on player feedback. Having a few random people putting real hours into world I (and some clankers) made. 

There's a free demo now, too, if anybody wants to give it a shot.

Would love to hear what other AI game devs think!
